hypotheses.statement: Convergent statistical and morphological evidence links Cyprus Cypro-Minoan (CM 1 & CM 2) to 1st-millennium Amathus Eteocypriot while separating CM from both Linear A and Greek: (1) Davis (2026b) 10-sign syllabotactic test gives EC↔CM z=+2.59σ (p=0.0097–0.0098, Hyp. 50), LA↔CM null (p=0.28–0.38, Hyp. 49), and CM1↔CM2 z=+2.62σ (p=0.0084, Hyp. 44); (2) our 10,000-shuffle IG XV 1 suffix permutation test finds bimodal alignment—CM 1 matches the -o-ti pole (cos=0.616, p=0.0139) and CM 2 matches the -na/-no/-ni/-ra pole (cos=0.583, p=0.0135), while CM 3 is null (p=0.1950); (3) 4,411-word non-onomastic lexicon tests reject Ugaritic (p=1.000), Hurrian (p=0.710), Anatolian (p=0.085–0.100), and CM 2 Greek (p=0.405). Per Egetmeyer (2017) & Janko (2020, 57 n. 58), Golgoi non-Greek syllabic texts ('Golgian') must be kept separate from Amathus Eteocypriot.

hypotheses.statement: Line-wrap-joined, strictly unbroken alignment of attested Cyprus CM 1+2 words (N=299 types L>=2, synthetic paradigm stems and §7 41-text holdout excluded) against Amathus-only IG XV 1 Eteocypriot (Confirmed tier: 92 types, 90 L>=2, 71 L>=3; Strict undotted tier: 66 types, 64 L>=2, 50 L>=3) calibrated across B=5,000 unrestricted (p_unr), vowel-preserving (p_vpres), and V-vs-CV class-preserving (p_vcv) syllable bijections isolates a suggestive lexical/morphological cluster and a statistically significant suffix-bigram signal: (1) distinct L>=3 consonant-skeleton stems (deduplicating ta-ra-we₂ and ta-ra-wo₂ to 1 stem): 2 stems (ta-ra-wV <-> ICS 193 ta-ra-wi / ICS 194 ta-ra-wo; a-sa-na <-> ICS 194 a-so-na) vs Confirmed EC (p_unr=0.0396, p_vpres=0.0842, p_vcv=0.1152; 3 word forms p_vcv=0.0192) and vs Undotted EC (p_unr=0.0242, p_vpres=0.0548, p_vcv=0.0954); (2) exact L>=2 full-word matches: 3 (a-na, ta-na, ta-ra-wo₂; Confirmed p_vcv=0.1584, Undotted p_vcv=0.1130), where a-na (5 Amathus texts incl. bilingual ICS 196 a-na | ma-to-ri; Petit (cited in Steele 2013, 126) proposes demonstrative/article, which Steele rejects on p. 126) is line-medial in CM 2 (ENKO Atab 002 B.I.09, B.I.14) and ta-na is column-initial with lost right context (B.II.01); (3) 9 shared 2-syllable endings (-no-ti, -po-ti, -o-ti, -sa-na, -li-ja, -le-ja, -nu-pi, -ra-wo, -ra-ni) survive V-vs-CV permutation on strict Undotted EC (p_unr=0.0034, p_vpres=0.0108, p_vcv=0.0224; Confirmed p_vcv=0.0656), and CM 2 -pi-na mirrors standalone Amathus pi-na (ICS 194 L2, dotted ICS 193 L4; Steele 2013, 132). Sensitivity across 013/008 regimes: Davis unsplit (013=na) yields identical exact=3, csk_stems=2 (p_vcv=0.1174) and raises shared_suf2 to 11 (p_vcv=0.0088), whereas HoChyMin unsplit (013=to) collapses to null (exact=1 p_vcv=0.8084, csk_stems=1 p_vcv=0.4117). Controls: CM 3 Ugarit (N=48) is null (exact=0, csk_stems=0); 100 size-matched DAMOS Linear B Greek draws (N=299) average 0.65±0.68 exact (>=3 in 1.0%), 0.34±0.57 csk_stems (>=2 in 5.0%, 10-draw median p_vcv=0.7206), 7.10±2.18 shared_suf2 (median p_vcv=0.3238), and null shared_pre2 once V-vs-CV sign classes are preserved (median p_vcv=0.1749).
